questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All globes are ball.

All globes are map.

Conclusions:

(I): Some balls are map.

(II): All map are globe.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fd3e9b0ae6238ea15e386c998e312e15a8813ac9be5af517dcc304da6773ef2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a97937f44ec8a786273d59b1fd56ae189602cdb55ae90ff0aa6a5742e27e75e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some balls are map → Follow (As all globes are ball and all globes are map. As whole globes comes in both balls and map, therefore it is true)

(II) All map are globe → **Does not** follow (As all globes are map. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Varun ranked 34th from the top and 11th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Varun ranked 34th from the top and 11th from the bottom in his class.

Varun's Rank from Top = 34

Varun's Rank from Bottom = 11

Total Students = (Varun's Rank from Top) + (Varun's Rank from Bottom) - 1

Total Students = 34 + 11 - 1 = 44

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Town Q is to the east of Town P. Town R is to the south of Town Q. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the south of Town S. Town U is to the east of Town T. What is the position of Town U with respect to Town Q?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Town Q is to the east of Town P.

Town R is to the south of Town Q.

Town S is to the east of Town R.

Town T is to the south of Town S.

Town U is to the east of Town T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/053f32327407f0b5ecdfd463816d3acbddc02fc720f75bd56b98a5f86325e45b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2059e98f678a16d3ef2c7d7a1c1c26bf5538c29dbcbaf82c83faf9f72e7a0c07.png] 

Q is at the top-left region.

U is diagonally down to the right of Q (toward the south-east).

So, Town U is to the South-East of Town Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
